verdict.rationale: Docs claim strong API parity — custom objects get identical REST/GraphQL endpoints, views, permissions, and workflow triggers as built-in objects, plus a Metadata API to programmatically change the data model itself, and API-based imports/exports (twenty-docs-8,12,22,23,41,59). However, no evidence explicitly confirms full API control over dashboards, view configuration (kanban/calendar), or workflow authoring — these are described only as UI-driven, and one community report notes the REST API 'worked ok' but the product was 'pretty alpha-version' with unspecified small issues. missing for 10: explicit docs/proof that dashboards, saved views, and workflow definitions can be created/edited via API rather than only through the UI, and independent confirmation beyond one mixed community report.
